dataSources.label: World Development Indicators
dataSources.description:
World Development Indicators (WDI) is the World Bank's primary collection of development indicators, compiled from officially recognised international sources. It presents current and accurate global development data for more than 200 economies, including national, regional and global estimates.

1 variable, 216 places, 1960 to 2025; updated 2026-11-17.

Data made available under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) · [Publisher's page](https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037712/World-Development-Indicators) · [Croissant metadata](/croissant/dc/d/WorldBank_WorldDevelopmentIndicators)

dataSources.label: CO2 emissions per capita (Our World in Data)
dataSources.description:
Annual carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per person from burning fossil fuels and industrial processes (transport, electricity generation, heating, cement), excluding land-use change, in tonnes of CO2 per person.

1 variable, 219 places, 1750 to 2025; updated 2026-11-17.

Data made available under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) · [Publisher's page](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/co-emissions-per-capita) · [Croissant metadata](/croissant/DCProjectDataset_owid_co2_per_capita)
